name: Orc
description: Fierce, combative humanoid creature type with brutish features and often greenish skin, found on Dominaria, Tarkir and other planes.

timeline.summary: The Kathorran orc clans unite after a drought-walk to Mornhollow and find the All-Gleam.
timeline.quote: Starving, they embarked on a drought-walk to Mornhollow, where they found the All-Gleam.
